content: PostgreSQL document numbering: sequences give uniqueness/order but NOT gapless (nextval never rolls back; gaps from rollback/cache/crash are normal and fine for business docs). max()+1 in app code is the classic race (two concurrent reads return same max → duplicate; unique constraint catches it as 500). Gapless options: counter table (one row per scope: year/series) with SELECT FOR UPDATE inside the transaction, or single-statement CTE 'WITH x AS (UPDATE counter SET id=id+1 RETURNING id) INSERT ...'; both serialize writers on a hot row — keep transactions short. SERIALIZABLE + retry (P2034) alternative. For BAST monthly numbering: counter keyed by month or accept gaps with sequence+unique constraint. Number must be assigned inside the same transaction as the save.
